Please resume21:24:13 deployment contract from the current files and your new stage_rows_target_oryx.py, preserving frozen source/package/oracles and old copied review.

Finish source/pin-checked stopped Oryx qualification input/profile deployment and ONE central request for your already frozen JIT/interpreter cohort. Current Oryx generation25 belongs to6502; no launch before a fresh explicit grant. Preparation, host checks and mail responses do not require its release. Return readiness/request or a concrete blocker promptly. After both target engines pass, we can release separate readable stopped full-MOS review staging, not before. No GUI/hardware/publication.

The Author explicitly directs immediate mailbox responses, even during other work. Do not put substantive replies into a comment queue. Read and act within the existing bounded release now.
